title: Sells or monetizes personal data
description: The service sells personal data, or shares it with third parties for their own marketing or profit.

title: Broad or vague third-party sharing
description: Data is shared with unnamed 'partners', 'affiliates' or 'trusted third parties' without clear purpose or limits.

title: Indefinite or unspecified retention
description: Data is kept as long as the company wishes, or no retention period is stated.

title: No clear way to delete or access your data
description: The policy does not let users access, correct or delete their data, or makes it impractically hard.

title: Cross-site tracking and profiling
description: Uses cookies, pixels, fingerprinting or similar to track users across sites or build behavioral profiles.

title: Collects sensitive data
description: Collects health, biometric, precise location, financial, political, sexual-orientation or similar sensitive data.

title: Children's data handling
description: Collects data from children, or lacks safeguards and parental consent for minors.

title: Transfers data abroad
description: Data is transferred or stored in other countries without stating safeguards.

title: Policy can change without notice
description: The company may change the policy at any time, and continued use counts as consent, without notifying users.

title: Forced or bundled consent
description: Consent to unnecessary data uses is bundled with the core service, with no way to opt out.
